column4: The European Climate Law sets a binding target of at least 55% greenhouse gas emissions reduction by 2030, which will likely reinforce the Energy from Renewable Sources target of at least 42.5% of the Union's energy consumption coming from renewable sources by 2030.

The European Climate Law's emission reduction target may aid in the reduction of emissions from land transport, thus reinforcing the amended Directive 2003/87/EC's goal of reducing emissions from the transport sector.
The European Climate Law's target may facilitate the amended Regulation (EU) 2018/842's objective of reducing emissions from the buildings sector by promoting the use of renewable energy sources.

The European Climate Law's emission reduction target may support the amended Regulations (EU) 2018/841's goal of reducing emissions from the land use sector by promoting sustainable land use practices.

column2: On an EU Strategy to reduce methane emissions
column4: The European Climate Law's target may enable the achievement of the methane emissions reduction strategy by promoting the use of renewable energy sources and reducing emissions from the energy and transport sectors.

column1: On the deployment of alternative fuels infrastructure
column4: The alternative fuels infrastructure deployment may facilitate the Sustainable and Smart Mobility Strategy's objective of promoting low-carbon transport by providing the necessary infrastructure for alternative fuels.

column1: On the Energy Transition of the EU Fisheries and Aquaculture sector

column4: The promotion of renewable and low-carbon fuels in maritime transport may reinforce the Sustainable and Smart Mobility Strategy's goal of reducing emissions from the transport sector.
